evidence: Plaut. Merc. 748: Ecce autem periī, coquos adest. — Advēnimus.
terms.comment: What Plautus’s cook says as he walks up with his helpers. The perfect says that the arriving is done: here we are.

evidence: Plaut. Curc. 353: et nōs, quibus parātum est, assumus
terms.comment: Of being on the spot rather than of the journey’s end; Plautus’s edition spells it assumus. See also I’m here, Adsum.

phrases.english: Here we are. Knock on the door.

phrases.latin: Ecce autem periī, coquos adest. — Advēnimus.
phrases.english: Oh no, here’s the cook, I’m done for. — Here we are!

sources: Lewis & Short: advenio · Lewis & Short: adsum
